sentences.japanese: ボブは酷く取り乱していて、現実と虚構の区別がほとんど出来なかった。
sentences.english: Bob was so beside himself that he could scarcely tell fact from fiction.

sentences.japanese: その犬に酷く足を噛まれた。
sentences.english: The dog gave his leg a mean bite.

sentences.japanese: スキャンダルは彼の清潔なイメージを酷く傷つけた。
sentences.english: The scandal has badly damaged his clean image.

sentences.japanese: 勝負をしましょう。より酷い暴言を吐いた方が勝ちです。
sentences.english: Let's have a contest. The side to come up with the worst insult wins.
